text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text: Yes, right away!

text_block_list.text:

anxious doing it alone... I definitely 
want to make it a success!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:

really, truly giving it their absolute 
all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:

want to deliver them to you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:

work together, we can definitely make 
something even better...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Will you support me?

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

Valentine's Day a massive success♡

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:

it on LANE, go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: What?! You went that far for me...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:

I'd even go harvest cacao beans!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:

to shine! Because Ai-chan's the one making 
it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:

down with everything you've got~~!

text_block_list.text: ...! Pandora-san...!

text_block_list.text:

best!

text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.text: You can do it, Ai-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.text:

Ai-chan's the one who really worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:

lots of praise!

time!

text_block_list.text: The truly amazing one is Ai-chan, got it?!

so she's making it with super-serious 
effort...!"

text_block_list.text:

truly—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I can totally tell you love your Trainer 
so much!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:

Aaai-chaaaan!

text_block_list.text: P-Pandora-san...!

text_block_list.text: Oof!

text_block_list.text: Ah... Ugh...

text_block_list.text: ...You're very welcome!
